# All settings

Every setting of the window that the User guide and the Feature reference describe in a settings table, grouped by where it is: the model-tree page, the dialog or the menu. Use the search box (or your browser's find) with the label as it appears in the window, or with the configuration field saved in the `.pinn.json` file.

Each row gives the label, a short meaning, the default, the allowed values and the configuration field. What the setting does in detail, its mathematics, how it interacts with other settings and its limitations are on the pages linked under **Explained in**. Which methods can be combined is on [Compatibility of methods](compatibility.md).

!!! note "Defaults"
    **Default** is the value the window shows for a new problem (a loaded example sets its own values). When an older problem file lacks a field, the field takes the `PINNConfig` default listed on [Configuration schema](../developer/config.md#field-reference); the two can differ.

This page is generated by `tools/docs/make_settings_index.py` from the settings tables of the other pages, so it changes when they do.

| **Growing time range: each window trains on [start, t] (one network)** | Approach I | off | needs transfer learning | `ta_growing` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Backward compatibility (bc-PINN): keep the solution on earlier windows** | bc-PINN | off | needs transfer learning | `ta_backward` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Weight:** | Loss weight of the backward-compatibility terms | 100 | 0–10⁶ | `ta_backward_weight` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Times/window:** | Stored times per window | 10 | 1–1000 | `ta_backward_times` | [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Points:** | Stored points in space (a random subset of the window grid when it has more) | 2000 | 1–1,000,000 | `ta_backward_points` | [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |

| **Points per round:** | Points added per round | 200 | 1–100,000 | `ta_resample_points` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Candidates per round:** | Random candidate points drawn in the window each round, ranked by residual | 10,000 | 100–1,000,000 (at least **Points per round:**) | `ta_resample_candidates` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |
| **Adam iterations per round:** | Training after each round | 2000 | 1–1,000,000 | `ta_resample_iters` | [Adaptive training](../guide/adaptive.md#settings-on-this-page), [Time windows and bc-PINN](time-windows.md#settings) |

| Animation: **Frames:** (20), **Frame rate (fps):** (10), **Resolution (DPI):** (150), **Line width:** (3), parameter-convergence animation settings | — | — | — | `num_timesteps_anim`, `plot_fps`, `plot_dpi_anim`, `plot_linewidth_anim`, `param_anim_*` | [Plots and data export](plots.md#plot-settings-tabs) |
| Loss: **Show:** (Train + Test totals, Each loss term, Totals and each term), **Line width:** (2), **Loss axis:** (logarithmic), **Record every:** (1000 iterations) | — | — | — | `loss_plot_mode`, `loss_plot_linewidth`, `loss_plot_log_y`, `loss_display_every` | [Plots and data export](plots.md#plot-settings-tabs) |

## Error Analysis dialog

| Setting | Meaning | Default | Allowed values | Config field | Explained in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Line comparison …** / **Surface comparison …** | Comparison figures | on / on | — | `ea_do_line`, `ea_do_surface` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **Surface comparison (PINN &#124; Reference &#124; Error)** | Surface figure | on | — | `ea_do_surface` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog) |
| **L2 Relative** | Compute and show the relative L2 error | on | — | `ea_metric_l2` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **MSE** | Compute and show the MSE | off | — | `ea_metric_mse` | [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **Max Error** | Compute and show the maximum absolute error | off | — | `ea_metric_max` | [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **Reference:** | Reference files or Exact solution formula | Reference files | — | `ea_ref_mode` (`files`, `formula`) | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| reference files | List of (time, file[, output]) | none | — | `ea_files` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| formula rows (*name* =) | Exact solution per output in `x, y, z, t` (numpy names, `erf`, `norm_cdf`) | blank | — | `ea_ref_formula` (`|`-separated) | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **Compare at times:** | Comparison times | blank = 5 evenly spaced over \( [t_{\min}, t_{\max}] \) | comma-separated | `ea_ref_times` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |
| **Grid:** | Points per axis of the formula's reference grid | 0 = 201 (1D), 101 (2D), 31 (3D) | integer | `ea_ref_grid` | [Error Analysis](../guide/error-analysis.md#settings-in-this-dialog), [Error metrics](metrics.md#settings) |

## Restore & visualize page

| Setting | Meaning | Default | Allowed values | Config field | Explained in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Model file:** | The saved `.pt` file | — | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page), [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Config:** | The model's configuration: `<model>.json`, else `model_config.json`, else (time windows) the step's `step_config.json` | found automatically | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page), [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Combine all detected steps into one full-domain animation** | For a model inside a time-window run: use every window | on when steps are found | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page), [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Optimizer used for this model:** | Adam or L-BFGS (how the model is compiled before restoring) | from the config | — | not saved | [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Parameter names:** | Inverse models whose config lacks them | blank | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page) |
| **Plot type:** | Surface, Line (time steps), Animation Line (GIF), Animation Surface (GIF); inverse: Parameter Convergence, Parameter Convergence (GIF) | Surface (Parameter Convergence for an inverse model) | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page), [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Output:** | An output, or **Custom...** with an expression and label | Output 1 | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page), [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Parameter names:**, convergence files (**➕ Add parameter file**), **Figures:**, **Log-scale y-axis** | Inverse models: the `<name>_convergence.txt` files, found in the run folder | found automatically | — | not saved | [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Save to:** | Folder for the new figures | — | — | not saved | [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
| **Convergence files and true values:** | Inverse: `<name>_convergence.txt` files and true values | found in the run folder | — | not saved | [Restore & visualize](../guide/restore.md#settings-on-this-page) |
| mode | **Forward Model** or **Inverse Model** (set from the config when it names unknowns) | Forward Model | — | not saved | [Checkpoints and restoring](checkpoints.md#restore-visualize) |
